method: Primary/source-index discovery notes, not catalog-query successes; exact raw query evidence stored separately.

sources.claim: BNP reports custody of 7.5 million bibliographic/documentary materials across 19 repositories; not 7.5 million lending books.
Official table: 491,942 books, PRINT AND ELECTRONIC combined, December 2024; updated March 2025. Includes specified PUCP libraries, not every possible bibliographic unit.
State news agency reports Pedro Zulen has over 214,000 titles and390,000 volumes. Article date requires confirmation; indexed publication metadata inconsistent.
Official FAUA account describes university Koha access to printed books and2025 open-shelf work; UNI university/faculty library system is institutional proxy.
Official UNALM page names Biblioteca Agrícola Nacional as national agricultural information center and lists implementation of Sophia. Indexed official evidence; live source unavailable.
2021 cataloguing manual describes30 active libraries: central unit, 22 central-campus specialized libraries, 6 filial libraries and Museo Inka.
UNA Puno catalog homepage claims over 120,000 titles and lists central, specialized and satellite units. Scope may include theses and other types.

2016 official regulation governs central and specialized libraries; external users require permission and on-site use, with registration/payment provisions. Historical rules need current confirmation.
Official UNSCH site describes central library across3 thematic levels, specialized libraries and student/teacher loans. Animated zero counters are NOT a collection size.
UNSM official ROF article 97 defines central and specialized library system serving student formation; institutional network proxy.
MALI reports over 15,400 volumes, 413 special materials and over 1,000 periodical titles, and Koha deployment; separate units should not be summed.
IEP describes35,000-plus books/periodicals, inconsistently calling them volumes and titles; reading room public, home/interlibrary loans restricted to IEP personnel.

Official state newspaper describes2021 public union project and Koha support, choosing municipal libraries by regional reach, internet and processing readiness. Proposal is not verified present national coverage.
BNP reports 40 new municipal public libraries in15 regions completed June2025; this is infrastructure expansion, not proof all40 are in queried union.
PUCP announces shared search among PUCP, Universidad del Pacífico, Universidad de Lima and UPCH; four universities are not verified here.
BCRP2024 procurement identifies Alma library management plus Primo VE discovery; institution-specific evidence, not market share.
Universidad Continental2025 ExLibris user event describes Alma/Primo experiences including BCRP implementation.
UNMSM Derecho self-evaluation says2018 migration from Koha to Simphony (source spelling). Not proof all faculties currently migrated.
BNP Colección Peruana is consultation in reading room; no home lending there, registration and DNI required.
